subject: general
question: Which is a major tributary of Bhagirathi river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhilangna.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhilangna** is the major tributary of **Bhagirathi river, **which is one of the two main tributaries of river Ganga.
 
• The Bhilangna river originates from the **Khatling glacier in the Garhwal region** of Uttarakhand and meets **Bhagirathi river at Old Tehri.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dhauliganga **is a tributary of** Alaknanda river,** which is the other main tributary of river Ganga.
 
• It originates from the **Niti Pass in the Chamoli district **of** Uttarakhand** and joins** Alaknanda river at Vishnuprayag.**
 
• **Pindar** is also a tributary of **Alaknanda river**, which originates from the** Pindari glacier in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand** and joins Alaknanda river at Karnaprayag.
 
• **Bishenganga** is a river that flows through the states of **Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh **and joins Wainganga river, which is a tributary of **Godavari river.**
